why: rc30: list font follows the sliders, more options

args.notes:
WoWFA Forever 1.0.0-rc30 (test build, built by wowfa2 CI).

Fix: the Persian text of the quest list (beside the map) and of the quest tracker ignored every size slider and used the game's own small size. It now follows the font size slider of General and a new slider on the Quests page (quest list size, default 110 percent, 70 to 160). Lines already on screen resize at once.
New: System lines can be switched per group in General: loot and money, experience / level / quests, reputation / skills / new spells, group and AFK.
New: a size slider for the red alerts in the middle of the screen (General).
New: the alert "There is no loot." is Persian.
Includes rc7 to rc29.

Data from ForeverDB.net
